mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar_url, email, status, pwd_reset_required, last_login_at, last_login_ip, version, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_admin WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar_url, email, status, pwd_reset_required, last_login_at, last_login_ip, version, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_admin WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT r.code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_admin_role ar ON ar.role_id = r.id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND r.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_admin (id, username, password, nickname, status, pwd_reset_required) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{status}, #{pwdResetRequired})
INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_admin_role (admin_id, role_id) SELECT #{adminId}, id FROM sys_role WHERE code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND status = 1
